retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1960s pop aesthetic featuring cutout portraits against a geometric polka-dot background with bold, multi-colored sans-serif and script typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant square composition featuring two high-contrast cutout portraits of a male and female performer. The background consists of a pink field with large, darker pink circular patterns. The layout is framed by a thick blue border and topped with massive, overlapping block typography in cyan and lime green.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical placement of two figures flanking a central text block
High-contrast black shadows against saturated neon color fields
Layered hierarchy with large block headers and smaller script subtext
Geometric background pattern contrasting with organic human forms
coreInvariants: Thick solid-color outer border framing the entire square composition
High-contrast, almost posterized treatment of photographic subjects
Overlapping large-scale sans-serif display type at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two waist-up portraits positioned on the left and right thirds, scaled to fill the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright cyan and green block text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top header, moves down to the central script text, then outward to the two faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Filled with a repetitive circular 'polka dot' pattern in shades of pink.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Hot pink and magenta circular patterns in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black in the clothing and hair of the subjects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric cyan, lime green, and bright yellow for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation across all hues with crushed blacks for graphic impact.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold condensed sans-serif and casual mid-century script.
letterConstructionRules: Display type uses ultra-tight tracking and heavy vertical strokes
Script type features bouncy baselines and rounded terminals
Secondary display type is stacked vertically in a small block
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'AND' is scaled down significantly to fit between the two primary names
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact block sans-serif paired with a playful, informal script for rhythmic contrast.

preserve: The cyan/green color split in the header
The staggered layout of the script text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed verticality of the main header.
Captures the mid-century casual script feel of the central text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square composition with a thick royal blue border. Inside, place a pink background with large, slightly darker magenta circles. Add two high-contrast, cutout-style portraits of a man and a woman in 1960s attire, one on the left and one on the right, leaving the center and top clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, extra-bold condensed sans-serif text across the top in cyan and lime green. In the center between the figures, add a four-line staggered stack of casual yellow script text.

verificationChecks: Is the blue border thick and consistent?
Are the portraits high-contrast with deep black shadows?
Is the top text large enough to dominate the upper third?
Is the background pattern composed of large circles?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or faces

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp cutouts for the subjects

postGenerationChecks: Check that the cyan and green text does not bleed into the blue border.
Ensure the script text is legible against the patterned background.
Verify the halftone effect is visible in the portrait shadows.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast duo portraits + geometric polka-dot background + oversized neon block type + thick framing border.
